title: Deployment & CI/CD Architecture
purpose: CI pipeline (GitHub Actions: parallel backend test + frontend lint/build), deployment targets (Netlify production, Cloudflare Pages preview, Render backend), Docker Compose local dev, and external service connections.
audience: DevOps engineers, developers setting up local environments
description: Complete deployment architecture showing the GitHub Actions CI pipeline (push/PR triggers parallel backend jest tests and frontend ESLint + Vite build), deployment targets (Netlify for production frontend at podm.app, Cloudflare Pages for PR preview deploys, Render for backend Express API auto-deploy), Docker Compose local development setup (frontend Vite dev server + backend ts-node-dev, no database container—relies on remote Supabase), and all 6 external services consumed by production backend. Highlights that E2E tests are NOT in CI and that the frontend Dockerfile runs the dev server (not production build) for local development.

preconditions: GitHub repository has CI workflow file at .github/workflows/ci.yml
Netlify is linked to GitHub repo with production branch configuration
Render web service is configured to auto-deploy from main branch
Cloudflare Pages project is configured for PR preview deployments
All external service credentials are configured in deployment environment variables
postconditions: CI pipeline runs backend tests and frontend lint/build for every push/PR
Successful CI on main/master triggers deployments to Netlify and Render
PRs automatically deploy preview frontends to Cloudflare Pages
Deployed backend connects to all configured external services

decisions.truePath: J2 → CFP (PR deploys preview to Cloudflare Pages)
decisions.falsePath: J2 → NET (push to main deploys production to Netlify)

errorPaths.destination: Deploy to Render blocked. Developer notified via CI status.
Frontend build may still proceed if lint is warning-only. Deploy proceeds.
Deploy to Netlify and Cloudflare Pages blocked.
Previous deployment remains active. No automatic rollback.
errorPaths.recovery: Manual intervention: check logs, fix configuration, redeploy.

validationRules: Backend tests must pass before Render deployment (manual gate)
Frontend must build successfully before Netlify/Cloudflare deployment
Environment variables must be configured in each deployment target
businessRules: Only push to main/master triggers production deployments
PRs only deploy preview frontends (no preview backend)
E2E tests are NOT included in CI pipeline—must be run manually
Local Docker Compose does not include a database container—uses remote Supabase
securityConsiderations: Frontend .env exposes VITE_ prefixed variables to client bundle—secrets must never use this prefix
Backend .env contains all API keys and service credentials—must not be committed
Netlify environment variables are injected at build time, visible in build logs
No staging environment exists—only production and local dev
performanceConsiderations: CI jobs run sequentially within each job but parallel across jobs
Backend test suite runs Jest with no caching—full install on every run
Frontend build generates production bundle on every CI run

annotations.text: Only 1 controller test and 1 service test exist—coverage is minimal
Proxies /api/* requests to Render backend via netlify.toml redirect rules
Runs Vite dev server in container—not suitable for production use
No PostgreSQL container—local development relies on remote Supabase instance
